description:
Venue model with GA capacities and full reserved seating: in-house authoring of sections/rows/seats, map versioning safe against sold inventory.

**Conditions of Success:**
- Staff can author and edit a seat map in the back office UI
- Maps are versioned; edits never orphan or duplicate sold/held seats
- GA and seated configurations coexist per venue

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map).

comments.body: COS defined at epic level. Not yet decomposed — US-stories are created when the owner prioritizes this epic (Gate 1), per PRD 'Capability map'.
